reuse.why: Instead of extracting the local-state part of unlinkAccount into a shared helper, it copies unlinkAccount's account-clearing update into the link guard.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount that resets an account to 'unlinked' is duplicated verbatim from unlinkAccount, so what 'unlinked' means now lives in two places.

placement.why: The flag is threaded through the shared ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, which keeps it to one place, but a function named and used as a guard now also mutates another account.

scope.why: Production change is focused, but the test diff includes reformatting churn of the existing closed-account test.

maintainability.why: A maintainer must keep two copies of the unlink field reset in sync and would not expect a side effect from an 'ensure…IsNotLinked' check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts re-implements unlinkAccount's local reset instead of sharing it (e.g. splitting unlinkAccount into a local-reset helper and the provider cleanup).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied update is literal, with a comment acknowledging unlinkAccount, not disguised.
